title: Jetski4you "Toronto jetski rental"
specs: Jet skis have large trunks and compartments for personal belongings
Jet skis can reach speeds of 80-110 km/h
Located 5-10 minutes jet ski ride from downtown Toronto
Must have a driver's license and be 21 years old to rent
Must be 20 years or older with a valid Ontario G2/G driver's license or equivalent
Passengers do not need a driver's license
Minimum weight for children riding is 30 lbs (13.5 kg)
Can host groups as large as 10 to 20 people with advance booking
Maximum 3 people per jet ski (2 adults and 1 child)

blurb: Guests rent jet skis for various durations and ride on Lake Ontario near Toronto. They receive a free temporary boating license and safety instructions before riding. The location offers parking and a relaxation area.

quotes.author: Nazar Detsyk
quotes.text: Nazar Detsyk01:13 24 Sep 24Unforgettable Jet Ski Experience!I had an amazing time riding jet skis with this company! The staff were professional, safety-conscious, and made sure we had everything we needed before heading out. The equipment was top-notch, and the thrill of speeding across the water was unmatched. The views were incredible, and it was a great mix of adrenaline and fun. Highly recommend if you’re looking for an exciting water adventure!

quotes.author: Anastasiia Nikolaeva
quotes.text: Anastasiia Nikolaeva17:50 10 Sep 24Me and my friend rented a jet ski from this company 2 times and both times were great. The owner is very friendly - he explained how everything works and the best prectises on water, so the onboarding was really easy. Jet skis are very powerful and easy to manage- we enjoyed driving fast (being careful of course). Overall, a really great experience - would recommend to everyone!
